Code Disharmonies




God Classes

Problem and recommended solution for God Classes
Problem: God Classes take on too much responsibility,
Solution: Extract related islands of functionality into separate classes. Leave God classes that don't change often alone.

Data Classes

Problem and recommended solution for Data Classes
Problem: Data Classes are dumb data holders that other classes rely on.
Solution: Move the data/variable(s) to the same class as the operation.

Refused Parent Bequest

Problem and recommended solution for Refused Parent Bequest
Problem: Child class is large and often complex, but doesn't override or use many of the parent class's methods
Solution: Do one or more of the following:
- Extract the child class into a separate class. Move the methods that are used from the parent class into the child class.
- Make unused protected members private in the parent class.
- If a parent class has multiple children, move methods not used by all descendants to another class.

Intensive Coupling

Problem and recommended solution for Intensive Coupling
Problem: Method calls too many methods from a few unrelated classes (often in a separate package).
Solution: Move the calling method to a class more closely related to the other classes that the original method can call.

Dispersed Coupling

Problem and recommended solution for Dispersed Coupling
Problem: Method calls a few methods in many classes
Solution: Reduce the size of the calling method. Extract methods from the calling method into the target classes.

Shotgun Surgery

Problem and recommended solution for Shotgun Surgery
Problem: Method is called by many methods in many classes
Solution: - Move the method closer to the calling classes (move the behavior closer to the data) if it is small.
- If it is a large method, treat it as a Brain Method and decompose it into two or more smaller methods.
